strategy_roster.name: Ma Adx
strategy_roster.notes: Price above MA(20) with ADX(14) > 25 confirms a strong trend; exit on close back through MA. Corpus exit is reverse MA cross or stop, take-profit set to 2x ATR which is not representable as fixed pct; left null. StopLossPercent=2 documented.

strategy_roster.name: Donchian Breakout
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > donchian_high_prev(high,20) and close > ema(close,50) and rsi(close,14) > 50
strategy_roster.notes: 20-bar Donchian upper breakout (prior-bar channel high per DSL) confirmed by EMA(50) trend and RSI(14) > 50; exit on opposite 10-bar lower breakout (ExitLength=10 documented). Corpus ATR-based stop (AtrMultiplier=1.5, AtrLength=14) not representable as fixed pct; left null. Documented volume/ATR envelope filters omitted as values are undocumented.

strategy_roster.name: Moving Average Crossover Swing
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(ema(close,5), ema(close,10)) and close > ema(close,50) and macd(close,12,26) > macd_signal(close,12,26,9)
strategy_roster.notes: Fast EMA(5) crosses above medium EMA(10) with slow EMA(50) trend filter and MACD histogram above zero (EnableSlow/EnableMacd true by default); ATR-based stop/take (1.4x/3.2x ATR14) not representable; left null. MACD periods undocumented in defaults; standard 12/26/9 used. Exit on fast/medium reverse cross.

strategy_roster.name: Bollinger Bands Long
strategy_roster.notes: Close below lower Bollinger band (BbLength=10, BbDeviation=2) with RSI(14) below oversold 30; exit when price returns to the middle band. No stop documented; left null. Distinct from prior 20-bar BB reverts via shorter 10-bar length.

strategy_roster.name: Double Bollinger Bands Signals
strategy_roster.notes: Long when close crosses back above the 3-SD lower band (Length=20, Width2=3); exit when close crosses above the 2-SD upper band (Width1=2). Short side omitted (long-only engine). No stops documented; left null.

strategy_roster.name: RSI Donchian
strategy_roster.notes: Fade-exhaustion breakout: RSI(14) oversold (<30) while price breaks prior 20-bar channel high; exit when close falls back through the Donchian middle line. Corpus 'Donchian Middle' approximated as (channel high + channel low)/2 (DSL has no mid-band primitive). StopLossPercent=2 documented.

strategy_roster.name: Bollinger Volume
strategy_roster.notes: Close above upper Bollinger band (20,2) on volume above 1.5x its 20-bar baseline (VolumeMultiplier=1.5 documented); exit when price returns to the middle band. Corpus ATR-based stop (StopLossAtr=2, AtrPeriod=14) not representable as fixed pct; left null.

strategy_roster.name: Rate of Change
strategy_roster.notes: Zero-line crossover of ROC(365) detects long-run momentum regime (RocLength=365); exit on opposite zero cross. Corpus bubble threshold (180) and dynamic fixed-ratio sizing are not representable; daily zero-cross core only. StopLossPercent=6 documented.

strategy_roster.name: Good Mode RSI v2
strategy_roster.notes: Ultra-short-horizon RSI(2) dip below buy level 4; exit when RSI reaches take-profit level 80. Corpus trailing stop in ticks not representable; left null. Extreme-oscillator variant, expected to trade frequently.

strategy_roster.name: RSI + 1200
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) crosses above oversold 28 while close sits within 1% of the multi-timeframe EMA(150) trend filter; exit when RSI rises above overbought 72. Higher-TF 120-minute EMA approximated as EMA(150) on the same bar (dsl lacks ref()/MTF). StopLossPercent=10 documented.
